title: CMake target inspection can execute an unqueued reconfigure
body: The seemingly read-only command cmake --build build/wsl --target help triggered CMake reconfiguration and codegen outside the global with-test-lock queue. The build workflow should expose a non-executing target-list query or fail early when invoked without the queue; the exact accidental command was cmake --build build/wsl --target help, and the intended workflow is the queued VIXEN build target.

title: Pinned VIXEN codegen does not vendor the generated VoxelDocument face
body: Pinning the private kernel join regenerated RecipeSimd and dispatch, but the joined document-default contract left VIXEN/libraries/SVO/include/Recipe/generated/VoxelDocument.g.h stale. I had to run the kernel SourceGenerator VoxelDocumentEmitterTests with UPDATE_GOLDENS=1, then manually copy Packages/com.utility.sdf/Runtime/GPU/Generated/VoxelDocument.g.h into VIXEN. The consumer pin/codegen target should materialize and check all generated faces together.

title: Windowed VIXEN GPU witnesses require manual DISPLAY provisioning
body: The documented queued GPU environment exports Vulkan variables but does not set DISPLAY or unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY for the editor's windowed capture. The first queued witness exited 255 before AppFlow with glfwInit failed (DISPLAY=<unset>); rerunning with DISPLAY=:0 and unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY passed. The queue/capture helper should provision the documented windowed environment automatically.

title: Paired Undertow author CLI needs an explicit private-kernel codegen rebuild
body: Running the author CLI against the private join with -p:UndertowCodegenEnabled=false used a stale generated RecipeDocument codec and rejected a valid v5 default-material document as an invalid legacy material region. The paired workflow should make YEROKET_ROOT=<join> and a full queued codegen rebuild part of the documented bake route; the recovery command was dotnet build tools/Undertow.Author.Cli/Undertow.Author.Cli.csproj -c Release -nodeReuse:false under the real queue.

title: Editor witness packs include schemas.json that author bake rejects
body: The editor capture pack carries schemas.json for the VIXEN launcher, but undertow-author bake treats the same file as an unknown authored asset and refuses the pack. I had to stage a second pack containing only manifest.utdl, materials.utdl, render_recipes.utdl and recipes/hull.vxd. The editor-to-author handoff should define one shared pack manifest/attachment contract.

title: Windowed latency fixtures do not carry schemas consistently across resolutions
body: The latency witness could not start from the pixel-1920 fixture because pixel-1920/pack/schemas.json was absent; I had to provision the schema from editor-windowed-1920/pack before running the queued witness. Capture fixtures should include their required launcher schema beside each resolution pack.

title: RenderGraph UI guard binaries require the module asset working directory
body: The named UI CPU guards are not runnable from the repository root or VIXEN source root because test_ui_kit.cpp and UiKit load assets/ui/kit and assets/ui/LatoLatin-Regular.ttf relative to CWD. I had to rerun from VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph for the module asset tree. The guard runner should set each module's asset-root working directory or expose an absolute fixture path.

title: Disabled VIXEN capture fixtures do not run their producers in queued guards
body: The generated CTest entries vixen_editor_capture_producer and vixen_hud_capture_producer are DISABLED on Linux, so the named critical-node guard starts without editor_capture_* or hud_capture_* artifacts. I had to invoke both producers manually in the same queued GPU payload before the assertions could run; the guard workflow should keep producer setup enabled and queue-aware.
